old: Light or dark, or as your system is now.
new: 浅色或深色，也可以跟随系统。

old: For the layout you're in: each layout keeps its own light and dark theme.
new: 只对当前布局生效：每个布局各自保留浅色与深色主题。

old: This layout sets its own; yours shows in the others.
new: 当前布局有自己的主题；你的设置在其它布局里生效。
影响全部内容：终端、面板与文字。
自动（美式键盘下为 Alt）

old: Use Option for terminal shortcuts or to type accents and special characters.
new: 让 Option 充当终端快捷键，或用来输入重音与特殊字符。

old: Copying this computer's herdr-core. Its terminals keep running.
new: 正在复制这台电脑的 herdr-core，其中的终端会继续运行。

old: New name (addresses using the old name stop working)
new: 新名称（使用旧名称的地址将失效）

old: Your computers, reached over ssh. Their terminals keep running when you disconnect.
new: 通过 ssh 连接的其它电脑。你断开后，其中的终端仍继续运行。

old: When an agent needs you, and when one finishes while you're not looking. A note shows in the corner either way.
new: 智能体需要你时，或你没在看时它完成任务，会播放音效。两种情况角落都会有提示。

old: Want your own sounds? Ask your agent to set sounds.done and sounds.blocked in settings.json to an MP3.
new: 想用自己的音效？让智能体把 settings.json 里的 sounds.done 和 sounds.blocked 设成 MP3 文件。

old: No successful check. Check your connection and try again.
new: 还没有成功的检查记录。请检查网络后重试。

old: A build from source: it updates with git, not here.
new: 这是从源码构建的版本：用 git 更新，不在这里更新。

old: Not checked: a build from source looks for no updates.
new: 未检查：从源码构建的版本不会查找更新。
正在更新…终端会继续运行。

old: Once a day: which agents and features you use, how many spaces and tabs, your system and Herdr's version. Never what's in your terminals, never names of files, folders or projects.
new: 每天一次：你用了哪些智能体和功能、空间与标签页的数量、你的系统与 Herdr 版本。绝不包含终端内容，也绝不包含文件、文件夹或项目名称。

old: This build never sends: it's built from source. You can still see what a release would send.
new: 此版本从不发送数据：它是从源码构建的。你仍可以查看正式版会发送什么。

old: Exactly what leaves your computer, word for word.
new: 即将离开你电脑的内容，一字不差。

old: Nothing is collected or sent while it's off.
new: 关闭期间不收集、不发送任何数据。

old: A draft: it changes until the day ends (UTC), then goes out once.
new: 草稿：到当天结束（UTC）前会变化，之后发送一次。

old: Herdr looks for both every hour and tells you in the corner. herdr-core runs your terminals, so they keep running through its updates.
new: Herdr 每小时检查两者一次，并在角落提示你。herdr-core 承载你的终端，因此更新期间终端会继续运行。
